Play trainrot world

Network data and puzzle times

Trainrot World includes 98 frozen city networks. Coverage follows the source snapshot and can omit operators, stations or service variants. Maps are schematic; this is a routing puzzle, not a journey planner.

Scheduled networks use representative daytime GTFS service patterns and median scheduled running times. Estimated networks use published station connections and mapped distances, with a fixed speed by rail mode and 25 seconds per stop. Every model adds four minutes per transfer and excludes initial waits and live delays. The result is the fastest route under that city’s puzzle model.

Citylines-derived databases and OpenStreetMap-derived geography are available under the Open Database License 1.0. Individual contents are covered by the Database Contents License where applicable. Agency data retains its source terms. Each city’s downloadable network JSON contains its provenance, timing model and source version; the public JSON is the complete derived database used by the game.

Sources include agency GTFS, Citylines, and the Tiny Trains published network snapshots, derived from the operators credited below. No application code, artwork, or 3D assets from that project are included.
